# 评审人 wangxiyuan: "I think we can delete this file"
# pangu_moe.py 旧文件保留（已由 torchair 版本 torchair_pangu_moe.py 替代）

from typing import Optional, List
import torch
import torch.nn as nn

from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe import FusedMoE
from vllm_ascend.models.pangu_moe import PanguProMoESparseMoeBlock

class PanguProMoESparseMoeBlock(nn.Module):
    """Legacy Pangu MoE sparse block - superseded by torchair version."""

    def __init__(self, config, ...):
        super().__init__()
        self.config = config
        self.experts = FusedMoE(...)

    def forward(self, hidden_states, ...):
        # 旧版实现，已由 torchair 版本替代
        router_logits = self.gate(hidden_states)
        return self.experts(hidden_states, router_logits)
